h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in West Bengal

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in West Bengal

items.pText: West Bengal runs from the Darjeeling hills in the north to the Sundarbans and the sea in the south. A playground plan for Siliguri will not suit a site in Kolkata or Digha. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for housing complexes, schools, municipal parks, industrial townships, clubs and resorts across the state.

Kolkata and Howrah bring the most enquiries, mainly from residential complexes, schools and neighbourhood parks run by local clubs. Durgapur and Asansol, in the steel and coal belt, have company townships and schools, and Kulti sits in the same belt. Kharagpur is a railway town with a large education campus, and Berhampore is a district town with schools and parks. Siliguri, at the foot of the hills, has new housing and hotels. We build every order at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, send it by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Humidity, heavy rain and the northern hills

c: Kolkata and south Bengal are hot and humid for much of the year, with heavy monsoon rain and storms near the coast. Raise the play area above the level where water collects, use galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts that do not rust, and lay rubber flooring that drains well. Near the sea, at Digha, rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time.
Darjeeling and the hill towns are cool and wet, with terraced sites, while the steel towns get hot, dusty summers. Residential complexes often pick a themed structure such as our

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a local club order equipment for a neighbourhood park?
items.a: Yes. Clubs and resident groups can contact us directly with the park size, photos and the age groups. We send suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote.

items.q: Which equipment holds up best in Kolkata's humidity?
items.a: Galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic slides, decks and panels. Both are corrosion-resistant. Keep drains clear around the base and check fittings after the monsoon.

items.q: Do you supply playgrounds in Siliguri and the hills?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road to Siliguri and the hill towns beyond it, and install with our team or a dealer. On terraced hill sites we suggest compact equipment with a drained base.
